messages:
Maya Patel: Quick ask for cost modeling — partners keep sending inconsistent CSVs. can someone propose a minimal normalized ingest spec we can require for marketplace/hw listings?

Jon Kim: yup. finance needs reserved vs spot blended rates, commit minimums, and credit timing so we can model amortization.

Priya Rao: Minimal columns we actually need: SKU, region, gpu_type, reserved_hour_usd, spot_hour_usd, reserved_commit_min_hours, reserve_tenor_months, min_reserve_granularity_hours, eviction_rate_pct, eviction_window_hours, preemptibility_type, billing_credit_type, credit_lag_days, burst_eligible, available_from, deprecation_date.

Evan Li: add preemptibility_state or window so routing can avoid short-term eviction windows for low-latency routes.

Kelsey (CoreWeave): sharing sanitized sample rows from CoreWeave (region-level):

```
SKU,region,gpu_type,reserved_hour_usd,spot_hour_usd,reserved_commit_min_hours,reserve_tenor_months,min_reserve_granularity_hours,eviction_rate_pct,eviction_window_hours,preemptibility_type,billing_credit_type,credit_lag_days,burst_eligible,available_from,deprecation_date
cw-a100-80-usw,us-west,A100-80,3.20,0.85,720,12,720,2.5,6,preemptible,monthly,14,true,2025-01-01,
cw-rtx6000-use,us-east,RTX6000,1.80,0.50,360,6,0,4.0,24,reclaimable,one-time,21,false,2024-09-01,
```

Maya Patel: can we clarify semantics: min_reserve_granularity_hours = 0 means hourly blocks ok; non-zero implies partner sells only blocks (e.g., 720h = monthly). billing_credit_type = monthly|one-time drives how finance applies credits.

Priya Rao: also request partners include "commit_id" or contract reference if applicable so we can reconcile credits to invoices. and include currency code (USD).

Jon Kim: on credit_lag_days 14/21 difference matters for cashflow. i'll add a cashflow line into our cost template to consume credit_lag_days.

Evan Li: operational note: for routing we should treat SKUs with eviction_rate_pct > 3% or eviction_window_hours < 12 as less reliable for p99 latency; propose a simple rule in the model: if eviction_rate_pct > 3 -> apply 10% latency penalty or mark non-preferred.

Kelsey (CoreWeave): will confirm whether eviction_rate_pct is reported per month or per billing period (we usually give monthly rates). we'll return full CSV with regional splits and min purchase sizes tomorrow.

Maya Patel: Priya, can you publish a one-page mapping doc describing each column and example semantics? then partnerships will send to vendors and marketplace will require mapping in onboarding.

Priya Rao: will do. draft mapping here:

```
SKU: partner's unique sku string (used for reconciliation). Example: cw-a100-80-usw
region: region code (cloud-like). Example: us-west
gpu_type: short gpu family. Example: A100-80
reserved_hour_usd: hourly price when using reserved commit. Example: 3.20
spot_hour_usd: ephemeral/spot hourly price. Example: 0.85
reserved_commit_min_hours: minimum qualifying hours for reserved price. Example: 720
reserve_tenor_months: contract length. Example: 12
min_reserve_granularity_hours: minimum sell block in hours (0=hourly). Example: 720
eviction_rate_pct: expected preemptions per period (percent). Example: 2.5
eviction_window_hours: typical continuous eviction window in hours. Example: 6
preemptibility_type: none|preemptible|reclaimable. Example: preemptible
billing_credit_type: monthly|one-time. Example: monthly
credit_lag_days: days until credit appears on invoice. Example: 14
burst_eligible: true|false whether workloads can exceed reserved pool. Example: true
available_from: ISO date when SKU starts (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2025-01-01
deprecation_date: ISO date when SKU retires or empty. Example: (nullable)
contract_ref: optional vendor contract id for reconciliation. Example: CW-2025-01
currency: currency code. Example: USD
```

Jon Kim: thanks. action items: Priya publish mapping + sample CSV; Kelsey deliver full CSV; Maya ask marketplace-pm to require mapping during listing; Evan add routing rule to prefer stable SKUs for low-latency endpoints; Jon update finance template to accept credit_lag_days and contract_ref.

supply-bot: Reminder: attach final CSV to partnerships/vendor-supply Drive folder within 48h.
